findings.subject: Current problem requirements and configuration

value.core_behavior: Align with original Ascend TBE PadV3Grad, logical-value comparison, all supported data types/formats and legal inputs, all test cases pass

findings.applicability: Current PadV3Grad problem v1 only; configuration observed now does not reconstruct an undisclosed historical judge environment. Thresholds alone do not specify the complete comparison algorithm.

findings.subject: Published ordinary-operator scoring rule

value.ordinary_problem_score: Average over all testcase scores, retained to two decimal places
value.TBest_definition: Historical fastest time for that testcase across all participants submissions
value.latest_submission_semantics: The latest submission replaces the represented ranking score, even when worse
value.ranking_testcase_count_null_display: All testcases counted; blank is all, 0 is none

findings.applicability: This is the official platform default-rule generator plus current config labels, not the contest-specific custom article text or an independently inspected backend. Applies to ordinary operators, not the distinct HCCL scoring branch. Use actual task-bound row.score instead of reconstructing it from hidden values.

findings.subject: Contest-specific published aggregate rule
findings.applicability: The article is linked by current contest scoring_rules_content. It supplies contest aggregation, not the numerical time-to-base-score formula, warmup, timing aggregation, degradation gates, or actual score_mode backend implementation. The platform generic difficulty text permits coefficients 1..5; do not use that generic range to overwrite this contest-specific 3/2/1 description. No tie-handling reconciliation is inferred.

findings.subject: Time display unit and iterations label

value.conversion: value >= 1000 is divided by 1000 for milliseconds display

findings.applicability: Display unit and current loop-count configuration only. Does not prove warmup count, inner timed repetitions, aggregation statistic, synchronisation, or kernel-only versus end-to-end timing.

findings.subject: Ranking pagination and binding

value.binding: Exact submission_id on ranking row, never branch name, user row alone, or theory_score

findings.applicability: Existing root page/size scan matches the actual frontend contract. Latest mode can replace older rows; a missing row is not score zero. Exact latest-mode replacement cause for any specific prior missing row remains unproven without an observed successor row.

findings.subject: Complete timing and degradation acceptance definition
findings.reason: Not specified in the examined current problem/contest text, linked official article, public default scoring text or relevant frontend display/config labels. iterations=5 and use_baseline=false are not substitutes for these definitions. No self-defined median/warmup or tolerance is introduced.
findings.applicability: Remain unknown until an official explicit measurement/acceptance specification or corresponding full official protocol is supplied.

findings.subject: Scoring edge conditions and strict cross-time scale equality
findings.reason: Published normal-case formula and two-decimal presentation do not disclose these boundary implementations. TBest dynamically changes with other submissions. Equality of five public TBest values and revision does not establish equality of forty-five hidden TBest values. Hidden inputs/metrics were neither accessed nor inferred.
findings.applicability: Keep all official task-bound observations; compare within explicitly stated observable conditions only. Do not turn one highest score or a score delta into stable speedup, full semantic proof, or automatic team-baseline approval.
